title: 駐輪場の精算機
description: 駅前の駐輪場に置く、自立式の料金精算機です。台座、淡灰色の本体と緑の傾斜屋根・帯、液晶画面、テンキー、硬貨・紙幣・カードの投入口、レシート口、つり銭受け、背面の保守扉の継ぎ目を造形しています。料金表・案内文などの文字、画面表示、決済機能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.500 × 1.419 × 0.400 m、2,160三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding pay station for station bicycle parking. It models the plinth, pale grey body with a green sloped hood and stripe, LCD screen, numeric keypad, coin, note and card slots, receipt slot, change tray and the rear service door seam. Price tables, instructions and other text, on-screen content and payment function are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.500 × 1.419 × 0.400 m; 2,160 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
